f.title: Apply NOM-012 to all health professionals and institutions conducting human research
f.statement: The standard is mandatory for every health professional and every public, social or private medical-care institution or establishment that intends to carry out or carries out health research in human beings with the characteristics indicated in the standard's objective.

rows.actor: Health professionals and medical-care institutions conducting research
rows.quote: Esta norma es de observancia obligatoria, para todo profesional de la salud, institución o establecimiento para la atención médica de los sectores público, social y privado, que pretendan llevar a cabo o realicen actividades de investigación para la salud en seres humanos, con las características señaladas en el objetivo de la presente norma.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'de observancia obligatoria' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Removed from the statement the description of the standard's objective (medicines lacking efficacy evidence etc.), which is not in the quote. Below 90: scope provision ('de observancia obligatoria') rather than a discrete PV action; HTML entity artefact ('ñ') in the quote does not affect meaning.
rows.quote_en: This standard is mandatory for every health professional, institution or establishment for medical care in the public, social and private sectors that intends to carry out or carries out health research activities in human beings with the characteristics indicated in the objective of this standard.

f.title: Treat unexpected signs and symptoms from experimental manoeuvres as adverse effects
f.statement: For the purposes of NOM-012, an adverse effect is the set of uncalculated and unexpected signs and symptoms that occur in a research subject as a consequence of applying the experimental manoeuvres foreseen in a health research project or protocol in human beings and that potentially represent a risk to his or her health.
f.applicability: Defines the adverse effects to be reported under items 8.7-8.10 and 10.9
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: 4.5 Efecto adverso , al conjunto de signos y síntomas no calculados e inesperados que se presentan en un sujeto de investigación, como consecuencia de la aplicación de maniobras experimentales previstas en un protocolo o proyecto de investigación para la salud en seres humanos y que potencialmente representen un riesgo para su salud.
rows.review_note: Review: moved the extractor's link to items 8.7-8.10 out of the statement into applicability (not in the quote). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Below 70: definition with no modal verb; Mandatory level and actor are not supported by the quote itself.
rows.quote_en: 4.5 Adverse effect: the set of uncalculated and unexpected signs and symptoms that occur in a research subject as a consequence of the application of experimental manoeuvres foreseen in a health research project or protocol in human beings and that potentially represent a risk to his or her health.

f.title: Ensure research exposes subjects to no unnecessary risk and benefits exceed risks
f.statement: All research must guarantee that it does not expose the research subject to unnecessary risks and that expected benefits are greater than the foreseeable risks inherent to the experimental manoeuvre.

rows.quote: 5.5 Toda investigación debe garantizar que no expone al sujeto de investigación a riesgos innecesarios y que los beneficios esperados son mayores que los riesgos predecibles, inherentes a la maniobra experimental.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'debe garantizar' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'debe garantizar' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred ('Toda investigación').
rows.quote_en: 5.5 All research must guarantee that it does not expose the research subject to unnecessary risks and that the expected benefits are greater than the foreseeable risks inherent to the experimental manoeuvre.

f.title: Describe in the protocol how subject safety is guaranteed
f.statement: For authorisation, the research project or protocol must describe in detail the elements and conditions that allow the Secretariat to evaluate the guarantee of safety of research subjects; Good Clinical Research Practices may be observed where applicable.

rows.quote: 5.6 Para la autorización de una investigación, conforme al objetivo y campo de aplicación de esta norma, el proyecto o protocolo de investigación debe describir con amplitud los elementos y condiciones que permitan a la Secretaría, evaluar la garantía de seguridad de los sujetos de investigación, en su caso, podrá observar las Buenas Practicas de investigación clínica.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'debe describir' = Mandatory; GCP observance is permissive ('podrá') and is stated as such. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'debe describir' = Mandatory; GCP part permissive and stated as such. Below 90: actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: 5.6 For the authorisation of research, in accordance with the objective and scope of this standard, the research project or protocol must describe in detail the elements and conditions that allow the Secretariat to evaluate the guarantee of safety of research subjects; where applicable, it may observe Good Clinical Research Practices.

f.title: Fund continuity of treatment and compensation for research-related harm
f.statement: The research budget shall include a financial fund and mechanisms to guarantee continuity of medical treatment and the compensation legally due to a subject who suffers harm directly related to the research; this fund may be covered by study insurance.

rows.quote: 5.14 En el presupuesto de la investigación deberá incluirse la disponibilidad de un fondo financiero, así como los mecanismos para garantizar la continuidad del tratamiento médico y la indemnización a que legalmente tendrá derecho el sujeto de investigación, en caso de sufrir daños directamente relacionados con la misma; en su caso, este fondo financiero puede ser cubierto con el seguro del estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberá incluirse' = Mandatory; insurance option is permissive ('puede'). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberá incluirse' = Mandatory; insurance option permissive. Below 90: actor inferred; HTML entity artefact ('ñ') in the quote does not affect meaning.
rows.quote_en: 5.14 The research budget shall include the availability of a financial fund, as well as the mechanisms to guarantee the continuity of medical treatment and the compensation to which the research subject will legally be entitled in case of suffering harm directly related to it; where applicable, this financial fund may be covered by the study insurance.

f.title: Describe medical-emergency resources in the authorisation submission
f.statement: The written submission attached to the authorisation request shall list a generic description of the resources available for managing medical emergencies according to the type of study. Medical care shall be provided with the institution's own resources or through third parties, and this fact shall be stated in that generic description.

rows.quote: 6.3.2.9 Descripción genérica de los recursos con que se cuenta para el manejo de urgencias médicas, de acuerdo con el tipo de estudio de investigación que se desarrolle. La atención médica deberá brindarse con recursos propios o a través de terceros, este hecho se deberá consignar en el contenido de la descripción genérica a que se refiere el presente numeral; y
rows.review_note: Review: statement corrected - the source requires that emergency medical care be provided (own resources or third parties) and that this be recorded, not merely 'stating whether'. Re-translation: fixed (the extractor's statement weakened 'deberá brindarse' to a disclosure; quote_en itself agrees). Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberá brindarse / consignar' = Mandatory. Below 90: list item whose submission lead-in is outside the quote; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: 6.3.2.9 Generic description of the resources available for managing medical emergencies, according to the type of research study being carried out. Medical care shall be provided with own resources or through third parties; this fact shall be recorded in the content of the generic description referred to in this item; and

f.title: Assign responsibility for follow-up, research harm and timely information to the Secretariat
f.statement: The head of the institution, the Research, Research Ethics or Biosafety Committees, the principal investigator and, where applicable, the sponsor are responsible within their competence for follow-up of the research; harm to health arising from it, including harm from early interruption or suspension of treatment not attributable to the subject; punctual compliance with the authorisation terms; and timeliness of information to be submitted to the Secretariat.

rows.actor: Institution head, committees, principal investigator and sponsor
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'serán responsables' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'serán responsables' with explicit actors. Below 90: responsibility allocation (judgement-call level); garbled 'E tica' (split word) in the committee name and 'C umplimiento'.
rows.quote_en: 7.2 The head of the institution or establishment, the Research, Research Ethics or Biosafety Committees, the principal investigator and, where applicable, the sponsor will be responsible, according to their sphere of competence, for: a) Follow-up of the research; b) Harm to health arising from the conduct of the research, as well as harm arising from the early interruption or suspension of treatment for reasons not attributable to the research subject; c) Punctual compliance with the terms on which the authorisation of health research in human beings was issued; d) Timeliness of the information that must be submitted to the Secretariat.

f.title: Guarantee sponsorship will not cause interruption of subject treatment
f.statement: Where the research is sponsored by a public or private body, it shall be guaranteed that this will not create conflicts of interest that could interrupt the subject's treatment, attaching to the protocol a detailed explanation of the available resources and how they will be provided and distributed.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: 7.4.5 En caso de que la investigación sea patrocinada por algún organismo público o privado, deberá garantizarse que ello no generará conflictos de intereses que puedan provocar la interrupción del tratamiento para el sujeto de investigación, para lo cual deberá anexarse al proyecto o protocolo de investigación una explicación detallada de los recursos con que se cuenta y la forma en que serán proporcionados y distribuidos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberá garantizarse / anexarse' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred (impersonal passive).
rows.quote_en: 7.4.5 Where the research is sponsored by a public or private body, it shall be guaranteed that this will not generate conflicts of interest that could cause the interruption of treatment for the research subject, for which a detailed explanation of the available resources and the way they will be provided and distributed shall be attached to the research project or protocol.

f.title: Have capacity to provide medical care for any adverse effect of the experimental manoeuvre
f.statement: All research in human beings shall be carried out in an institution or establishment with sufficient infrastructure and response capacity to provide adequate medical care, directly or through third parties, in the presence of any adverse effect of the experimental manoeuvre.

rows.actor: Institution or establishment where research is carried out
rows.quote: 8.1 Toda investigación en seres humanos, deberá realizarse en una institución o establecimiento, el cual deberá contar con la infraestructura y capacidad resolutiva suficiente, para proporcionar la atención médica adecuada o en su caso, a través de terceros, ante la presencia de cualquier efecto adverso de la maniobra experimental expresada en el proyecto o protocolo de investigación autorizado.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberá realizarse ... el cual deberá contar' = Mandatory with the institution as explicit addressee; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 8.1 All research in human beings shall be carried out in an institution or establishment, which shall have sufficient infrastructure and response capacity to provide adequate medical care or, where applicable, through third parties, in the presence of any adverse effect of the experimental manoeuvre set out in the authorised research project or protocol.

f.title: Supervise research so subjects are not exposed to unnecessary harm or risk
f.statement: Every institution or establishment hosting research shall supervise and guarantee that it is conducted by health professionals following scientific and ethical principles, and that research subjects are not exposed to harm or to risks that are unnecessary or greater than the expected benefits.

rows.actor: Institution or establishment where research is carried out
rows.quote: 8.4 Toda institución o establecimiento en cuyas instalaciones se realice una investigación, deberá supervisar y garantizar que su desarrollo esté a cargo de profesionales de la salud, con apego a los principios científicos y éticos que orientan la práctica médica y que los sujetos de investigación no sean expuestos a daños ni a riesgos innecesarios o mayores que los beneficios esperados.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit (toda institución o establecimiento), 'deberá supervisar y garantizar' = Mandatory; HTML entity artefact ('ñ') in the quote does not affect meaning.
rows.quote_en: 8.4 Every institution or establishment on whose premises research is carried out shall supervise and guarantee that its conduct is in the charge of health professionals, in accordance with the scientific and ethical principles that guide medical practice, and that research subjects are not exposed to harm or to risks that are unnecessary or greater than the expected benefits.

f.title: Maintain a medical emergency service or an agreement with a higher-capacity facility
f.statement: Every institution or establishment carrying out or intending research must have a medical emergency service or, where applicable, a signed agreement with a medical-care establishment of greater response capacity that provides emergency care as a third party.

rows.actor: Institution or establishment where research is carried out
rows.quote: 8.6 Toda institución o establecimiento, en el que se lleve a cabo o se pretenda realizar una investigación, debe contar con un servicio para la atención de urgencias médicas. En su caso, se deberá contar con un convenio suscrito con un establecimiento para la atención médica de mayor capacidad resolutiva, que a manera de tercero, brinde dicha atención de urgencias.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'debe contar / se deberá contar' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 8.6 Every institution or establishment in which research is carried out or intended must have a service for medical emergencies. Where applicable, there shall be an agreement signed with a medical-care establishment of greater response capacity which, as a third party, provides such emergency care.

f.title: Notify the Secretariat of any adverse effect within 15 working days with outcome details
f.statement: The head of the institution or establishment must notify the Secretariat of Health of any adverse effect arising from the experimental manoeuvre within a maximum of 15 working days counted from its occurrence, including the care measures adopted, the sequelae identified and a detailed report on the patient's physical condition stating whether he or she is free of all risk at the time of notification.

rows.actor: Head of the institution or establishment
rows.deadline: Within a maximum of 15 business days (días hábiles) counted from the onset (presentación) of the adverse effect
rows.quote: 8.7 El titular de la institución o establecimiento, debe notificar a la Secretaría, cualquier efecto adverso derivado de la maniobra experimental, en un plazo máximo de 15 días hábiles contados a partir de su presentación, que incluya las medidas de atención adoptadas, las secuelas identificadas, así como un informe detallado sobre el estado físico del paciente, en el que se mencione si se encuentra libre de todo riesgo hasta el momento de la notificación.
data_elements: whether patient is free of risk
rows.review_note: Review: deadline wording made exact (15 business days, day zero = onset/presentation of the adverse effect); 'debe notificar' = Mandatory; actor (head of institution) matches. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit (titular), 'debe notificar' = Mandatory, deadline 15 días hábiles from presentación explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 8.7 The head of the institution or establishment must notify the Secretariat of any adverse effect arising from the experimental manoeuvre, within a maximum period of 15 working days counted from its occurrence, including the care measures adopted, the sequelae identified, as well as a detailed report on the physical condition of the patient, stating whether he or she is free of all risk up to the time of the notification.

deadline_rule.clock_start: contados a partir de su presentación
deadline_rule.applies_to: Any adverse effect arising from the experimental procedure in research on human subjects

f.title: Suspend or cancel research immediately on a severe adverse effect and notify the Secretariat
f.statement: The head of the institution, the Research, Research Ethics or Biosafety Committees or the principal investigator shall order immediate suspension or cancellation of the research in the presence of any severe adverse effect that is an ethical or technical impediment to continuing, and the Secretariat shall be notified in detail within the time indicated in item 8.7 (maximum 15 working days).

rows.actor: Institution head, committees or principal investigator
rows.deadline: Suspension immediately; notification within the 8.7 time frame (maximum 15 working days)
rows.quote: 8.8 El titular de la institución o establecimiento, los Comités de Investigación, E tica en la Investigación , Bioseguridad o el investigador principal, deberán ordenar la suspensión o cancelación inmediata de la investigación , ante la presencia de cualquier efecto adverso severo, que se constituya en impedimento ético o técnico para continuar con el estudio, acerca de lo cual, deberá notificar a la Secretaría, en forma detallada, con la oportunidad que se indica en el numeral 8.7.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; note the notification verb is singular 'deberá notificar' after a list of actors; actor kept as the list. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberán ordenar' = Mandatory. Below 90: singular 'deberá notificar' after a list of actors leaves the notifier ambiguous; 15-day limit comes from 8.7 by reference; garbled 'E tica' (split word) in the committee name.
rows.quote_en: 8.8 The head of the institution or establishment, the Research, Research Ethics, Biosafety Committees or the principal investigator shall order the immediate suspension or cancellation of the research in the presence of any severe adverse effect that constitutes an ethical or technical impediment to continuing the study, about which the Secretariat shall be notified in detail, with the timeliness indicated in item 8.7.

f.title: Obtain a new authorisation before resuming research suspended for safety
f.statement: Where research has been suspended or cancelled because of a severe adverse effect, resumption of the research requires a new authorisation.

rows.quote: En tal caso, la reanudación de la investigación requerirá de una nueva autorización.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; short quote carries the duty on its own ('requerirá de una nueva autorización'), context in location 8.8. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Below 90: 'requerirá' states a consequence, not a modal duty; 'En tal caso' refers to the preceding sentence; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: In that case, resumption of the research will require a new authorisation.

f.title: Inform the Research Ethics Committee of every related adverse effect
f.statement: The principal investigator shall inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research.
f.topic: Adverse event reporting to ethics committee
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: 8.9 El investigador principal, deberá informar al Comité de E tica en la Investigación , de todo efecto adverso probable o directamente relacionado con la investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; duplicated in the source by 10.9 (row 0024), kept as separate provisions. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'deberá informar' = Mandatory. Capped below 90: garbled 'E tica' (split word) in the committee name touches the recipient.
rows.quote_en: 8.9 The principal investigator shall inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research.

f.title: Report absence of adverse effects to the Ethics Committee at its set periodicity
f.statement: The principal investigator shall also inform the Research Ethics Committee, with the periodicity the Committee establishes, of the absence of adverse effects in the projects or protocols under his or her responsibility.
f.topic: Periodic safety reporting to ethics committee

rows.deadline: At the periodicity set by the Research Ethics Committee
rows.quote: Asimismo, deberá informar a dicho Comité con la periodicidad que la misma establezca, sobre la ausencia de efectos adversos en los proyectos o protocolos de investigación que estén bajo su responsabilidad.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberá informar' = Mandatory; periodicity set by the Committee. Below 90: subject of 'Asimismo, deberá' is the principal investigator from the preceding sentence, outside the quote.
rows.quote_en: He or she shall also inform that Committee, with the periodicity that it establishes, of the absence of adverse effects in the research projects or protocols under his or her responsibility.

f.title: Report serious or lethal adverse reactions to the Secretariat immediately
f.statement: Serious or lethal adverse reactions or effects must be reported immediately to the Secretariat of Health.

rows.quote: 8.10 Las reacciones o efectos adversos graves o letales deben ser reportados inmediatamente a la Secretaría.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; the source uses a passive ('deben ser reportados') and names no actor; actor is the reviewer's/extractor's reading of 8.7-8.9. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deben ser reportados inmediatamente' = Mandatory, deadline explicit. Below 90: passive with no actor; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: 8.10 Serious or lethal adverse reactions or effects must be reported immediately to the Secretariat.

f.title: Follow NOM-220 for suspected adverse drug effects in research
f.statement: In cases of suspected adverse effects of medicines in research, what is set out in the Mexican Official Standard referred to in item 3.2 must be observed.
f.applicability: Item 3.2 cites NOM-220-SSA1-2002, Installation and operation of pharmacovigilance, or the standard that replaces it (now NOM-220-SSA1-2016)

rows.quote: En los casos de sospecha de efectos adversos por medicamentos se debe observar lo que señala la Norma Oficial Mexicana, referida en el numeral 3.2 de esta norma.
rows.review_note: Review: statement now names the standard cited in 3.2 (NOM-220-SSA1-2002, 'o las que las sustituyan', i.e. now NOM-220-SSA1-2016). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Moved the identification of the 3.2 standard (NOM-220-SSA1-2002 / successor) from the statement to applicability (not in the quote). 'se debe observar' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred; cross-reference requirement.
rows.quote_en: In cases of suspected adverse effects of medicines, what is indicated in the Mexican Official Standard referred to in item 3.2 of this standard must be observed.

f.title: Ethics Committee to propose suspension or cancellation on impeding adverse effects
f.statement: The Research Ethics Committee shall propose to the head of the institution that the research be suspended or cancelled in the presence of any adverse effect that is an ethical or technical impediment to continuing the study.

rows.quote: 9.2.10 El Comité de E tica en la Investigación deberá proponer al titular de la institución o establecimiento donde se realice investigación para la salud, que se suspenda o cancele la investigación ante la presencia de cualquier efecto adverso que sea impedimento desde el punto de vista ético o técnico, para continuar con el estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'deberá proponer' = Mandatory. Capped below 90: garbled 'E tica' (split word) in the committee name in the actor.
rows.quote_en: 9.2.10 The Research Ethics Committee shall propose to the head of the institution or establishment where health research is carried out that the research be suspended or cancelled in the presence of any adverse effect that is an impediment from the ethical or technical point of view to continuing the study.

f.title: Direct the protocol according to subject-safety aspects
f.statement: The principal investigator must direct the research project or protocol in accordance with its methodological, ethical and research-subject safety aspects.

rows.quote: 10.2 El investigador principal podrá planear y elaborar el proyecto o protocolo de investigación y debe dirigir el mismo en apego a los aspectos metodológicos, éticos y de seguridad del sujeto de investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; planning/drafting is permissive ('podrá') and not captured; the row covers 'debe dirigir'. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'debe dirigir' = Mandatory; permissive planning part not captured; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 10.2 The principal investigator may plan and prepare the research project or protocol and must direct it in accordance with the methodological, ethical and research-subject safety aspects.

f.title: Apply life-saving amendments immediately with Ethics Committee approval, then seek authorisation
f.statement: Where the life of research subjects is in danger, amendments to the protocol may be applied immediately with prior approval of the Research Ethics Committee and subsequently with the authorisation of the Secretariat of Health; documentary evidence of all of this shall be kept.
f.applicability: Amendments where the life of research subjects is in danger (exception to the general 10.3 rule that methodological amendments need a new Secretariat authorisation after a favourable Committee opinion)

rows.deadline: Immediately (after Ethics Committee approval); Secretariat authorisation afterwards
rows.quote: En los casos en que se encuentre en peligro la vida de los sujetos de investigación, las enmiendas podrán ser aplicadas de inmediato, previa aprobación del Comité de E tica en la Investigación y posteriormente con la autorización de la Secretaría, de todo lo cual, deberá quedar constancia documental.
rows.review_note: Review: removed from the statement the general new-authorisation rule, which is not in the quote (moved to applicability as context). Level Permitted ('podrán') with a mandatory record ('deberá quedar constancia documental'). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'podrán ser aplicadas' = Permitted with 'deberá quedar constancia'. Below 90: passive, actor inferred; garbled 'E tica' (split word) in the committee name; mixed permitted/mandatory content.
rows.quote_en: Where the life of research subjects is in danger, the amendments may be applied immediately, after approval by the Research Ethics Committee and subsequently with the authorisation of the Secretariat, of all of which there shall be documentary evidence.

f.title: Suspend research when required under the General Health Law
f.statement: The investigator is responsible for suspending the research in accordance with fraction VI of Article 100 of the General Health Law.
f.legal_basis: Ley General de Salud Art 100 fracción VI

rows.quote: 10.5 El investigador es responsable de suspender la investigación, de conformidad con lo establecido en la fracción VI del artículo 100 de la Ley General de Salud.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit; 'es responsable de suspender' read as Mandatory. Below 90: responsibility wording (judgement-call level) with the trigger defined only by reference to LGS Art 100 VI.
rows.quote_en: 10.5 The investigator is responsible for suspending the research, in accordance with fraction VI of Article 100 of the General Health Law.

f.title: Inform subjects during the study of the implications of each experimental manoeuvre
f.statement: The principal investigator is responsible for informing the research subject, relative, guardian or legal representative during the research of the implications of each experimental manoeuvre and the characteristics of the condition, and where applicable of the advisability of a therapeutic option suited to the subject.

rows.quote: 10.8 Es responsabilidad del investigador principal informar al sujeto de investigación, al familiar, tutor o representante legal, durante el desarrollo de la investigación, acerca de las implicaciones de cada maniobra experimental y de las características de su padecimiento. Asimismo, deberá informar en su caso, acerca de la conveniencia de tomar una opción terapéutica adecuada a sus características particulares.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'Es responsabilidad' / 'deberá informar' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'Es responsabilidad ... informar' and 'deberá informar' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 10.8 It is the responsibility of the principal investigator to inform the research subject, the relative, guardian or legal representative, during the conduct of the research, about the implications of each experimental manoeuvre and the characteristics of his or her condition. He or she shall also inform, where applicable, about the advisability of taking a therapeutic option suited to his or her particular characteristics.

f.title: Investigator to inform the Ethics Committee of every related adverse effect
f.statement: The investigator must inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research.
f.topic: Adverse event reporting to ethics committee
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: 10.9 El investigador debe informar al Comité de E tica en la Investigación de todo efecto adverso probable o directamente relacionado con la investigación.

rows.quote_en: 10.9 The investigator must inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research.

f.title: Share responsibility for subject safety among institution, investigator and sponsor
f.statement: The safety of the research subject regarding the experimental manoeuvre is the responsibility of the institution or establishment, the principal investigator and the sponsor, under item 7.2.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.1

rows.quote: 11.1 La seguridad del sujeto de investigación respecto del desarrollo de la maniobra experimental, es responsabilidad de la institución o establecimiento, del investigador principal y del patrocinador, en los términos del numeral 7.2, de esta norma.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.1
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actors explicit. Below 90: 'es responsabilidad' allocation (judgement-call level), defined by reference to 7.2.
rows.quote_en: 11.1 The safety of the research subject with respect to the conduct of the experimental manoeuvre is the responsibility of the institution or establishment, the principal investigator and the sponsor, under item 7.2 of this standard.

f.title: Continue free care after withdrawal until research-related harm is excluded
f.statement: When a subject withdraws consent, the principal investigator must ensure that he or she continues to receive care and treatment at no cost until there is certainty that there was no harm directly related to the research.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2

rows.quote: Cuando esto suceda, el investigador principal debe asegurar que el sujeto de investigación continúe recibiendo el cuidado y tratamiento sin costo alguno, hasta que se tenga la certeza de que no hubo daños directamente relacionados con la investigación.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'debe asegurar' = Mandatory, actor explicit. rows.quote_en: When this happens, the principal investigator must ensure that the research subject continues to receive care and treatment at no cost, until there is certainty that there was no harm directly related to the research.

f.title: Withdraw a subject when risk outweighs benefit
f.statement: The principal investigator may withdraw a research subject from the research if, during it, the risk is considered greater than the benefit and requires withdrawal.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2.1

rows.quote: 11.2.1 En su caso, el investigador principal también podrá retirar al sujeto de investigación para que deje de participar en ella, si considera que durante el desarrollo de dicha investigación, el riesgo es mayor que el beneficio y que por tal motivo obligue a su retiro.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2.1
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'podrá retirar' = Permitted. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'podrá retirar' = Permitted, actor explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 11.2.1 Where applicable, the principal investigator may also withdraw the research subject so that he or she stops participating in it, if he or she considers that during the research the risk is greater than the benefit and that for that reason withdrawal is required.

f.title: Provide continued treatment at study end to prevent discontinuation effects
f.statement: To guarantee subject safety at the end of the research, the principal investigator shall make the necessary provisions for treatment and care to continue, to prevent side effects arising from discontinuation of the experimental manoeuvre.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2.2

rows.deadline: At the end of the research
rows.quote: 11.2.2 Para garantizar la seguridad del sujeto de investigación, al término de ésta, el investigador principal deberá proveer lo necesario para que se continúe con el tratamiento y cuidados, a fin de evitar que se presenten efectos secundarios derivados de la suspensión de la maniobra experimental que le haya sido practicada.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.2.2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'deberá proveer' = Mandatory, timing (al término) explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 11.2.2 To guarantee the safety of the research subject, at the end of the research the principal investigator shall provide what is necessary for treatment and care to continue, in order to prevent side effects arising from the suspension of the experimental manoeuvre applied to him or her.

f.title: Share safety responsibility when combining experimental and proven methods
f.statement: When the research combines an experimental-phase procedure with an already proven method, responsibility for the safety of the patient-research subject is shared between the investigator and the physician responsible for the proven method.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.4
f.applicability: Research combining experimental and proven methods

rows.actor: Investigator and physician responsible for the proven method
rows.quote: 11.4 Cuando la investigación implique la aplicación combinada de un procedimiento en fase experimental con otro método ya probado, la responsabilidad de la seguridad del individuo, a causa de su carácter de paciente-sujeto de investigación, será mancomunada entre el investigador y el médico responsable del método probado.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.4
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'será mancomunada' = Mandatory allocation of responsibility. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actors explicit. Below 90: 'será mancomunada' allocates shared responsibility (judgement-call level).
rows.quote_en: 11.4 When the research involves the combined application of a procedure in the experimental phase with another method already proven, responsibility for the safety of the individual, because of his or her status as patient-research subject, will be shared between the investigator and the physician responsible for the proven method.

f.title: Evaluate continuation of subjects with new comorbidity and record the decision
f.statement: If a subject presents signs and symptoms of an uncontemplated condition (comorbidity) not caused by the experimental manoeuvre but which could harm health or be complicated by it, the principal investigator shall evaluate whether the subject continues or is excluded (per 11.2.1), and record the decision and its justification in the subject's clinical record.
f.clause: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.6

rows.quote: 11.6 Si durante el desarrollo de un proyecto o protocolo de investigación, el sujeto que participe en ella, presenta signos y síntomas de una patología no contemplada (comorbilidad), que no sea consecuencia de la maniobra experimental y que pudiera llegar a generar daños a su salud o complicarse como resultado de dicha maniobra experimental, el investigador principal deberá evaluar la conveniencia de que el sujeto continúe o sea excluido de la investigación, en concordancia con el numeral 11.2.1, de esta norma. La decisión y su justificación deberán quedar registradas en el expediente clínico del sujeto de investigación.
rows.location: 11. De la seguridad física y jurídica del sujeto de investigación, 11.6
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit, 'deberá evaluar' and 'deberán quedar registradas' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing; HTML entity artefact ('ñ') in the quote does not affect meaning.
rows.quote_en: 11.6 If during a research project or protocol the participating subject presents signs and symptoms of a condition not contemplated (comorbidity) which is not a consequence of the experimental manoeuvre and which could harm his or her health or become complicated as a result of that experimental manoeuvre, the principal investigator shall evaluate the advisability of the subject continuing or being excluded from the research, in accordance with item 11.2.1 of this standard. The decision and its justification shall be recorded in the research subject's clinical record.

f.title: State compensation for research harm and free treatment in the informed consent letter
f.statement: When drafting the research informed consent letter, the investigator must make sure it meets the requirements of the Research Regulation and makes explicit that participation is free of charge, the compensation the subject is entitled to if he or she suffers health damage directly attributable to the research, and the availability of free medical treatment, even if the subject decides to withdraw before the research ends.
f.legal_basis: Reglamento de la LGS en materia de investigación para la salud

rows.quote: 10.6 Al formular la carta de consentimiento informado en materia de investigación, el investigador debe cerciorarse de que ésta cumpla con los requisitos y supuestos que se indican en el Reglamento, cuidando que se hagan explícitas la gratuidad para el sujeto de investigación, la indemnización a que tendrá derecho en caso de sufrir daños a su salud directamente atribuibles a la investigación y la disponibilidad del tratamiento médico gratuito para éste, aun en el caso de que decida retirarse de dicha investigación, antes de que concluya.

rows.quote_en: 10.6 When drafting the research informed consent letter, the investigator must make sure that it meets the requirements and conditions indicated in the Regulation, ensuring that the following are made explicit: that participation is free of charge for the research subject, the compensation to which the subject will be entitled in the event of suffering damage to health directly attributable to the research, and the availability of free medical treatment for the subject, even if he or she decides to withdraw from the research before it concludes.
